content.short: Gelato provides a decentralized Web3 backend to automate smart contracts and support off-chain tooling.
content.description: Gelato is an all-in-one Ethereum Rollup-as-a-Service platform built without limits. Designed for speed, security, and scalability, it enables anyone to build and deploy fully serviced Layer 2 chains. Gelato rollups integrate with Web3 tools and services to provide a production-ready Web3 development environment from the Genesis block, aligning development workflows with the broader Web3 ecosystem. This approach emphasizes speed, security, and scalable growth for projects seeking to deploy Layer 2 solutions.
